summary: Hiker lost the route descending Kit Carson Peak, missed the Avenue traverse, and was advised by phone to descend Spanish Creek; a SAR ground team ascended the Spanish Creek Trail, met the survivor, and descended without incident, giving her a ride back to her vehicle at the Willow Creek Trailhead.
location: South face of Kit Carson Peak / Spanish Creek drainage
notes: Source: Saguache County SAR Facebook page.
